maya (PM): Quick sync — Customer Orion private pilot needs launch criteria nailed down. Runtime/infra/security deps look hairy. Can we list blockers and owners?

alex (Eng Runtime): I can own runtime readiness: model pinning + canary variant. Need infra to guarantee burst GPUs for prewarm. ETA? :clock1:

sam (Infra): @alex we can reserve burst pools but need firm traffic window & commit on instance types (A100 vs H100). Also need IP allowlist from security.

rita (Security): IP allowlist + HSM/KMS integration for key wrapping. Also audit logs retention—customer needs 1yr. Will need legal signoff for data sitting on Dedicated.

tomas (SRE): We need SLAs on 99.9% latency for 95th pct. Suggest we define fallbacks: if p95 > Xms switch to smaller model or route to hosted. Who defines X?

maya (PM): Proposal: p95 target 250ms, fallback to quantized 13B model at 350ms. Agree?

alex (Eng Runtime): OK. We'll add a routing policy + automatic fallback. Need infra to expose node selectors for quant variants.

sam (Infra): can do node selectors + pre-warm hooks. Timeline: need capacity reservation by next Tue. Also need onboarding doc for ops.

june (DevEx): I'll write a playbook for the pilot: deployment checklist, rollback steps, eval prompts. Draft by EOD Friday.

rita (Security): For HSM/KMS I'll need a config snippet from Infra and runtime. Example config we expect:
```
kms:
  provider: cloud-kms
  key_id: projects/..../locations/.../keyR
hsm:
  enabled: true
  module: vendorX
audit:
  retention_days: 365
```

maya (PM): Ok action items: Alex runtime -> routing+fallback (owner alex) due Thu; Sam infra -> reserve burst pool + nodeSelectors (owner sam) due Tue; Rita security -> HSM/KMS signoff + audit policy (owner rita) due Wed; June -> pilot playbook due Fri. Tomas -> SLA & alert thresholds due Wed. I'll sync w/legal. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: New thread created by maya (PM) • created 1810002468

alex (Eng Runtime): noted, starting a PR for fallback policy. Will ping when ready.

sam (Infra): I'll put a tentative capacity PO and tag the infra ticket with customer-orion-pilot.

maya (PM): Great. Let's have a 20m async check-in Mon morning. If blockers surface, ping @maya. Thanks everyone.
